prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1319; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described above, which involved a low-speed head-on impact. Our client has sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation, and we expect the full extent of those injuries and the related losses to be documented in the coming weeks.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please notify us promptly.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, estimates, adjuster notes, recorded statements, claim file materials, and any communications with your insured or third parties. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained.
